mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a judgment declaring the legal rights of a party."
Declaratory judgment is a judgment declaring the legal rights of a party.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the name of the remaining portion of the Crown's original authority . .."
The prerogative is the name of the remaining portion of the Crown's original authority . . .

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a basic administrative law principle for over a century, and has been described as one of the hornbooks of administrative law in Withrow v."
The rule against bias is a basic administrative law principle for over a century, and has been described as one of the hornbooks of administrative law in Withrow v.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Latin word which literally means a "command" or an "order"."
Mandamus is a Latin word which literally means a "command" or an "order".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential process in a constitutional democracy founded upon the rule of law."
Judicial review of administrative action is an essential process in a constitutional democracy founded upon the rule of law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a process that culminates in the making of an 'order'."
Adjudication is defined as a process that culminates in the making of an 'order'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as one of the most conspicuous among the doctrines in judicial review of administrative decisions."
The principle of reasonableness is regarded as one of the most conspicuous among the doctrines in judicial review of administrative decisions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the right of an individual or group of individuals to bring an action before a court of law for adjudication."
Locus standi is the right of an individual or group of individuals to bring an action before a court of law for adjudication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means one thing in one system of government and an altogether different thing in another."
Judicial review means one thing in one system of government and an altogether different thing in another.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the term for the ability of a party to demonstrate to the court, sufficient connection to and harm from the law or action challenged to support the party's participation in the case."

Legal standing or locus standi is the term for the ability of a party to demonstrate to the court, sufficient connection to and harm from the law or action challenged to support the party's participation in the case.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the power of final interpretation of the statutory guides."
Theirs is the power of final interpretation of the statutory guides.
fib: ______ is the rule against excess or abuse of power; an act which is for any reason in excess of power (ultra vires) is often described as being 'outside jurisdiction'.
ultra vires doctrine
The ultra vires doctrine is the rule against excess or abuse of power; an act which is for any reason in excess of power (ultra vires) is often described as being 'outside jurisdiction'.
______ is concerned mainly with the control of power.
Illegality
Illegality is concerned mainly with the control of power.
______ is an order of court addressed to a party to a proceeding before it and requiring him to refrain from doing, or to do a particular act.
Injunction
Injunction is an order of court addressed to a party to a proceeding before it and requiring him to refrain from doing, or to do a particular act.
______ is the process by which an administrative agency issues an order, such order being affirmative, negative, injunctive, or declaratory in form.
Administrative adjudication
Administrative adjudication is the process by which an administrative agency issues an order, such order being affirmative, negative, injunctive, or declaratory in form.
______ is a procedure for obtaining remedies.
Take note that judicial review
Take note that judicial review is a procedure for obtaining remedies.
______ refers to limits on what government can regulate; Procedural Due Process refers to the procedures by which government may affect individuals' rights.
Substantive Due Process
Substantive Due Process refers to limits on what government can regulate; Procedural Due Process refers to the procedures by which government may affect individuals' rights.
______ is the provisions of the Constitution FRN 1979 and 1999 Constitutions.
good starting point
A good starting point is the provisions of the Constitution FRN 1979 and 1999 Constitutions.
______ means a preconceived notion, a predisposition or one-sided inclination.
Bias
Bias means a preconceived notion, a predisposition or one-sided inclination.
______ is concerned primarily with whether a particular claimant is entitled to invoke the jurisdiction of the court.
doctrine
The doctrine is concerned primarily with whether a particular claimant is entitled to invoke the jurisdiction of the court.
______ is a procedural step that informs people affected by a decision (and, potentially, the public) of the substance of a decision.
giving of reasons
The giving of reasons is a procedural step that informs people affected by a decision (and, potentially, the public) of the substance of a decision.
